text:
elliot: Quick recap from the partner sync — Brightlane wants SSO + immutable audit export in the MVP and will push to pilot if we commit. they said they'd fast-track payment if we take it.

jamie: Immutable export + SSO in MVP? that’s larger than just passthrough. what’s their required retention/export format?

elliot: They want signed exports (WORM-style), 30d retention, queryable for support traces. basically searchable audit artifacts they can pull.

nora: This touches storage, KMS, and compliance (WORM). timeline impact estimate is ~2.5 weeks if we accept.

patrick: Proposal: two cutlists and a conditional offer.
A) MVP-baseline: SSO core + event stream (customer sink) — no exports, timeline unchanged.
B) MVP-contract: SSO + signed export + 30d indexed audit (basic query) — +2.5w, infra + legal.

patrick: Quick delta sketch:
```
MVP-contract-impact:
  infra: +1 retention-store (WORM), +1 search replica
  security: KMS workflow + attestation work
  cost: approx +$9k/mo
  eng: ~+2.5w (1.0 FTE equivalent)
```

jamie: If Brightlane signs a short-term commitment (3 months infra cover) we can take B and do a thin roll for pilot. otherwise offer phased commitment.

nora: Legal: WORM & signed exports require a written data-handling addendum. we need legal review time in the estimate.

elliot: Sales asks for a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb we can give them now — something that conditions the MVP-contract on LOI and infra commitment.

patrick: Draft blurb idea: "We can include signed export and 30-day searchable audit artifacts in MVP conditioned on a written LOI covering three months of retention infrastructure costs and a legal data handling addendum." Thoughts?

jamie: Sounds fine. add: "delivery timeline will shift by ~2-3 weeks upon LOI confirmation" so they see trade.

ops-bot: Note: auth-service canary scheduled 2025-10-20 01:00 UTC — coordinate feature flags and retention migrations if selecting MVP-contract.

nora: If we accept a timeline reset, recommend trading non-customer-facing scope (internal telemetry rollouts, polishing of admin UI, and one infra refactor) to absorb time.

elliot: Action items: @patrick post full A/B cutlist with itemized time/cost/legal bullets by EOD. @elliot to get LOI deadline from Brightlane. reconvene tomorrow 10:00 PT to pick path. :thumbsup:
